name: defect-requirement-in-changes-section
body:
## Summary

Admins can delete an account when its owner asks.

## Change and measurable outcome

- `deleteAccount` marks the user deleted, clears their personal fields and ends their sessions.
- The account can no longer sign in.

## Changes

- In one transaction, with the user row locked:
  - the status becomes `deleted` and name and phone are cleared
  - all sessions are revoked
  - pending invites to the account's email are revoked

## Testing

- [x] Unit tests

## Notes for Reviewers

- Deletion is final; there is no undo.
